definitions.explanation: One's grandfather and grandmother collectively. A compound of {祖父|そふ} (grandfather) and {祖母|そぼ} (grandmother).

examples.english: I went to visit my grandparents' house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{祖父母|そふぼ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent the summer vacation with my grandparents.

examples.japanese: {祖父母|そふぼ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦お{年玉|としだま}→お年玉：08452_otoshidama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received New Year's money from my grandparents.

examples.japanese: {祖父母|そふぼ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧とも⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: Both my grandparents are living in good health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{祖父母|そふぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせてもらった→聞かせる：20926_kikaseru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often had my grandparents tell me stories about the old days.

notes:
FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ (grandfather - formal)
- ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧ (grandmother - formal)
- {祖父母|そふぼ} (grandparents)
- ⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧ (grandfather - common/polite)
- ⟦おばあさん→おばあさん：02863_obaasan⟧ (grandmother - common/polite)

USAGE: {祖父母|そふぼ} is more formal and is commonly used when talking about grandparents in general or in written contexts. In casual speech, おじい⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧ is more common.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧ (parents)
